pairs.notes: A has clean disabled-state management and a separate Start/Pause button model; B merges Start/Pause into one cycling button with a redundant separate Pause that creates duplicate toggle calls, and lacks mobile media queries.
Both are fully feature-complete; B earns the aesthetic edge with filled vs. outlined button hierarchy, a live status line, and a class-based OOP structure that keeps DOM queries clean.
Feature parity; B's 120px accent-colored timer is more visually impactful and its uniform outline button language is more internally consistent, narrowly edging A's solid dark inactive button style.
Both feature-complete; B's `clamp(60px, 15vw, 120px)` timer sizing is elegantly responsive and its filled-Start / outlined-Pause-Reset hierarchy communicates the primary action more clearly.
Both feature-complete; A has a better visual hierarchy with primary filled Start and secondary outlined Pause/Reset buttons, plus a mobile media query that B omits entirely.
